headline: Three ARC-2 teams storm into gold

sections.text: Domdolus Tolus surged from 549th to 12th, yuritosci from 1,374th to 14th, and Kajetan Schweighofer from 27th to 15th. All three moved into the 15 gold places.
Their arrival pushed Anil Thomas from 12th to 17th and out of gold. The cutoff now stands at 47.92 in 15th, a sharp turn at the medal line.
